TEXT.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. Overgeset inde Formosaansche tale, voor de Inwoonders van Soulang, Mattau, Sinckan, Bacloan, Tavocan en Tevorang. Amsterdam: Michiel Hartogh.

S.FORM: Tou kidi k'anna mama-ah ta Pei-sasou-an ki tounnoun ki vulluvullum ki sât kytti-æn ki kæuh-jnæjna, ka rou ni-ara nein ta poua-euingan nein, ni-tpæpænæh dmoumadoumma ki paræh ka va'æu.
S.TRANSL: Then shall the kingdom of heaven be likened unto ten virgins, which took their lamps, and went forth to meet the bridegroom.
「那時，天國好比十個童女拿着燈出去迎接新郎。

S.FORM: Ka rarymma ta nein ka matallahkau, rarymma-appa ta marynhgau.
S.TRANSL: And five of them were wise, and five were foolish.
其中有五個是愚拙的，五個是聰明的。

S.FORM: Neni ka marynhgau dou ni-ara nein ki pou-æuing-an nein, assi nein ni-ah-para ki jmagh.
S.TRANSL: They that were foolish took their lamps, and took no oil with them:
愚拙的拿着燈，卻不預備油；

S.FORM: Râ neni ka matallahkau ta ni-mara ki jmagh tou sato nein ahpara ki poutaæuing-an nein.
S.TRANSL: But the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps.
聰明的拿着燈，又預備油在器皿裏。

S.FORM: Jrou ka malanga ta Paræh ka va'æu, nimy-ymmid misorugh, ka meirip-ato.
S.TRANSL: While the bridegroom tarried, they all slumbered and slept.
新郎遲延的時候，她們都打盹，睡着了。

S.FORM: Jrou ka toukad ta euvan ni-pako-langæh-en', K'ytt'ei, irarouroua ta paræh ka va'æu, t'pæpænæh-ei, doumadouma-au tyni-æn.
S.TRANSL: And at midnight there was a cry made, Behold, the bridegroom cometh; go ye out to meet him.
半夜有人喊着說：『新郎來了，你們出來迎接他！』

S.FORM: Anna ta ni-æhpit ta ymmid ki kæuh-jnæjna k'anna, ka ni-siriang simimia ki pouæ-æugin an nein.
S.TRANSL: Then all those virgins arose, and trimmed their lamps.
那些童女就都起來收拾燈。

S.FORM: Ka marynhgau ta ni-k'ma ki matallahkau, P'heikame ki imagh-oumi, ka mioup ta pataæuing'nian.
S.TRANSL: And the foolish said unto the wise, Give us of your oil; for our lamps are gone out.
愚拙的對聰明的說：『請分點油給我們， 因為我們的燈要滅了。』

S.FORM: Râ ni-mattæ'i-v'lli ta matallahkau, k'ma, [Aassi,] alei lava ka assi mamsing-ah ymiæn-æn, ymoumi-æn-appa ta rouma: mouauro-â mou-koua tou papeil-lan, ka peil-ato ki âmoumi-ah.
S.TRANSL: But the wise answered, saying, Not so; lest there be not enough for us and you: but go ye rather to them that sell, and buy for yourselves.
聰明的回答說：『恐怕不夠你我用的；不如你們自己到賣油的那裏去買吧。』

S.FORM: Irou ka darang-en nein peila, ni-iroua ta Paræh ka va-'æu, ka neni ka ni-patau-tan, ni-toulam tyni-æn mourbo tou ibavauvatoug-han mavok, ka ni-ilben ta nḡataff.
S.TRANSL: And while they went to buy, the bridegroom came; and they that were ready went in with him to the marriage: and the door was shut.
她們去買的時候，新郎到了。那預備好了的，同他進去坐席，門就關了。

S.FORM: Si-æugh ni-irou'-appa ta kæuh-jnæ̈jna ka ra-rouma, k'ma, Meirang, Meirang, æu-lbei-kame.
S.TRANSL: Afterward came also the other virgins, saying, Lord, Lord, open to us.
其餘的童女隨後也來了，說：『主啊，主啊，給我們開門！』

S.FORM: Ka dou mattæ'i-v'lli ta teni ni-k'ma, Missing koun-nau-kamou-râ, assi koh kmalang ymoumi-æn.
S.TRANSL: But he answered and said, Verily I say unto you, I know you not.
他卻回答說：『我實在告訴你們，我不認識你們。』

S.FORM: Anna ta mahamæuæ-æ̈, ka assi-moumi oumhgan ta wæ'i ki kidi-appa ki tæ'lei ka irouah ta Alak ki ka'æuloung.
S.TRANSL: Watch therefore, for ye know neither the day nor the hour wherein the Son of man cometh.
所以，你們要警醒；因為那日子，那時辰，你們不知道。」

S.FORM: Râ mama [k'anna] ki ka'æuloung, ka dou thabul-ah moukoua tou pani ki pourough, ni-tmætææ̈m ki kouncia tyn, ka ni-pæ'æ̈-tounnoun-en tyn neini-æn ki hourup tyn.
S.TRANSL: For the kingdom of heaven is as a man travelling into a far country, who called his own servants, and delivered unto them his goods.
「天國又好比一個人要往外國去，就叫了僕人來，把他的家業交給他們，

S.FORM: Ka ni-pæ'æ̈-rymma-en tyn ki talenten ki naunamou, ni-pæ'æ̈-roua-en tyn ta kararouha, ni-pæ'æ̈ sât-en tyn ta katatourou, ta meihboua-voual na kidi ki pasiriang-eih tyn pasipyppyou, ka ni-madys thaboul.
S.TRANSL: And unto one he gave five talents, to another two, and to another one; to every man according to his several ability; and straightway took his journey.
按着各人的才幹給他們銀子：一個給了五千，一個給了二千，一個給了一千，就往外國去了。

S.FORM: Ka teni ka ni-â-rymma ki talenten, ni-d'marang p'æ'i-assa ki anna, ka ni-pou-than ki ryryma ka pani.
S.TRANSL: Then he that had received the five talents went and traded with the same, and made them other five talents.
那領五千的隨即拿去做買賣，另外賺了五千。

S.FORM: Komm'appa-hynna ta teni ka ni-â-douha, ni-pouthan ki rorouha ka pani.
S.TRANSL: And likewise he that had received two, he also gained other two.
那領二千的也照樣另賺了二千。

S.FORM: Râ teni ka ni-â-sât mara, ni-d'marang kmari tou næi, ka ni-ha tyn ta malyttouk ki Meirang tyn.
S.TRANSL: But he that had received one went and digged in the earth, and hid his lord's money.
但那領一千的去掘開地，把主人的銀子埋藏了。

S.FORM: Ka siæ̈ugh ki madallia ki kidi, ni-iroua ta Meirang ki kouncia k'anna, ka ni-kting tyn meisâl neini-æn.
S.TRANSL: After a long time the lord of those servants cometh, and reckoneth with them.
過了許久，那些僕人的主人來了，和他們算帳。

S.FORM: Ka teni ka ni-a-rymma ki talenten, ni-mou-koua maad ki ryrymma-appa ka pa-nni ki talenten, ka ni-koua tyn, Meirang ryrymma ki talenten ka ni-p'hæ-en-hou jau-an, k'ytt'ei, ryrymma-appa ka panni ki talenten, ka ni-pou-saoun-koh pou-than ki anna.
S.TRANSL: And so he that had received five talents came and brought other five talents, saying, Lord, thou deliveredst unto me five talents: behold, I have gained beside them five talents more.
那領五千銀子的又帶着那另外的五千來，說：『主啊，你交給我五千銀子。請看，我又賺了五千。』

S.FORM: Ka ni-k'ma tyni-æn ta Meirang tyn, Mamsing, kouncia ka mariang ka makidkid, ni-makidkid kow tou katiting-an, ka pasi-bavau-aumau kow ki madagh: Mou-rbo-â tou karei-en ki Meirang oho.
S.TRANSL: His lord said unto him, Well done, thou good and faithful servant: thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things: enter thou into the joy of thy lord.
主人說：『好，你這又良善又忠心的僕人，你在不多的事上有忠心，我要把許多事派你管理；可以進來享受你主人的快樂。』

S.FORM: Ka dou moukoua ta teni, ka ni-â-douha ki talenten, ni-koua tyn, Meirang, dourouha ki talenten ta ni-p'hæ-en-hou jau-an, k'ytt'ei, rourouha-appa ki pa-nni ki talenten ka ni-pou-saoun-koh pouthan.
S.TRANSL: He also that had received two talents came and said, Lord, thou deliveredst unto me two talents: behold, I have gained two other talents beside them.
那領二千的也來，說：『主啊，你交給我二千銀子。請看，我又賺了二千。』

S.FORM: Ka ni-k'ma tyni-æn ta Meirang tyn, Mamsing kouncia ka mariang ka makidkid, Ni-makidkid kow katiting-an, pasi-bavau-au-mau kow ki madagh: Mourbo-â tou karæi-en ki Meirang oho.
S.TRANSL: His lord said unto him, Well done, good and faithful servant; thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things: enter thou into the joy of thy lord.
主人說：『好，你這又良善又忠心的僕人，你在不多的事上有忠心，我要把許多事派你管理；可以進來享受你主人的快樂。』

S.FORM: Ka dou mou-koua ta teni ka ni-â-sât ki talent, ni-koua tyn, Meirang, k'alang-en-au kow ka ka'æuloung kow ka maplagh, ka majam kow ki assi'mhou na dadiri, ka pa-lud kow ki assi'mhou na sasasbugh.
S.TRANSL: Then he which had received the one talent came and said, Lord, I knew thee that thou art an hard man, reaping where thou hast not sown, and gathering where thou hast not strawed:
那領一千的也來，說：『主啊，我知道你是忍心的人，沒有種的地方要收割，沒有散的地方要聚斂，

S.FORM: Ka alei ki tahkout-au ni-d'marang-koh hmaa ki talent oho tourbo ki næi: k'ytt'ei, akoumea kow ki â'mhou.
S.TRANSL: And I was afraid, and went and hid thy talent in the earth: lo, there thou hast that is thine.
我就害怕，去把你的一千銀子埋藏在地裏。請看，你的原銀子在這裏。』

S.FORM: Râ ni-mattæ'i-v'lli ta Meirang tyn, k'ma tyni-æn, Kouncia ka mat'e, ka manhgad, kavanna-en-hou, ka majam koh tou assi-mau nad-adiri, ka palud-koh ki assi-mau na sasasbugh.
S.TRANSL: His lord answered and said unto him, Thou wicked and slothful servant, thou knewest that I reap where I sowed not, and gather where I have not strawed:
主人回答說：『你這又惡又懶的僕人，你既知道我沒有種的地方要收割，沒有散的地方要聚斂，

S.FORM: Anna ta ynna'mhou p'hei ta malitouk-au ki Tama-viri, ka dou irouato-koh, ni-alikough-au ta â jau lam ki than.
S.TRANSL: Thou oughtest therefore to have put my money to the exchangers, and then at my coming I should have received mine own with usury.
就當把我的銀子放給兌換銀錢的人，到我來的時候，可以連本帶利收回。

S.FORM: Anna ta hami-au ta talent k'anna, ka p'hæ-an-eito tyni-æn ka akoumea ki sât kyttiæn ki talenten.
S.TRANSL: Take therefore the talent from him, and give it unto him which hath ten talents.
奪過他這一千來，給那有一萬的。

S.FORM: Ka veiagh ka akoumea, teni ta p'heih, ka poudimm'eil-appa: râ teni ka aou-si, ara-eil-appa ta akoumea tyni-æn.
S.TRANSL: For unto every one that hath shall be given, and he shall have abundance: but from him that hath not shall be taken away even that which he hath.
因為凡有的，還要加給他，叫他有餘；沒有的，連他所有的也要奪過來。

S.FORM: Ka aryng-an-ei ta kouncia k'anna ka saramsam smaki-tauagh tyni-æn tou siouro itou-tauagh ka karimdim-man, tou hynna-al-ato ta tangi-tangi-an ki pa-it-ing-en-appa ki waligh.
S.TRANSL: And cast ye the unprofitable servant into outer darkness: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
把這無用的僕人丟在外面黑暗裏；在那裏必要哀哭切齒了。』」

S.FORM: Ka rou irou-'al-ato ta Alak ki ka'æuloung tou keirang-en ki kidi tyn, ymd'-appa ki Tama-Gnau ka dlligh matiktik tou-lam tyni-æn, anna ta ierrong-eih tyn tou iërrarong-an ki keirang-en ki kidi tyn.
S.TRANSL: When the Son of man shall come in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then shall he sit upon the throne of his glory:
「當人子在他榮耀裏、同着眾天使降臨的時候，要坐在他榮耀的寶座上。

S.FORM: Ka papa-sâl-eih tou æmæh tyni-æn ta ymmid ki ta'utaou, ka papæh-piæh-eih tyn ta neni k'anna mæi tou-tavætævæh mama ki sou-ajam ka papæhpiæh ki jouko ki jou.
S.TRANSL: And before him shall be gathered all nations: and he shall separate them one from another, as a shepherd divideth his sheep from the goats:
萬民都要聚集在他面前。他要把他們分別出來，好像牧羊的分別綿羊山羊一般，

S.FORM: Ka pa-itou-oual-eih tyn ta joukko, râ pa-itou-'u'i-eih tyn ta jou.
S.TRANSL: And he shall set the sheep on his right hand, but the goats on the left.
把綿羊安置在右邊，山羊在左邊。

S.FORM: Anna ta mattæ'i-komm'-al-appa-hynna ki sou ta Mei-sasou ka Si-bavau neini-æn ka itou-koua tou ouwal tyn, Mou-koua hia ta ymoumi ka ni-paka-riang-en-kamou ki sou ki Rama-au, tabli-ato ki Pei-sasouan ka ni tanang-in ymoumi-æn na kidi ki ni-paitou-samding-en ta raroun ki Næi.
S.TRANSL: Then shall the King say unto them on his right hand, Come, ye blessed of my Father, inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world:
於是王要向那右邊的說：『你們這蒙我父賜福的，可來承受那創世以來為你們所預備的國；

S.FORM: Ka ni-mahgang-ei-koh, ka ni-pakan-'noumi jauan: Ni-mytokoh, ka ni-pa-yt-'noumi jau-an: Ni-tæ'ækoua-en-at-'mau, ka ni-paih-tatallagh-'noumi jau-an.
S.TRANSL: For I was an hungred, and ye gave me meat: I was thirsty, and ye gave me drink: I was a stranger, and ye took me in:
因為我餓了，你們給我吃，渴了，你們給我喝；我作客旅，你們留我住；

S.FORM: Ni-mannana, ka ni-papah-koulamough-kamou jau-an: Ni-malam-koh, ka ni-douoy-kamou-jauan: Ni-æ'ia-koua-en-au tou sangat, ka ni-mou-koua-kamou jau-an.
S.TRANSL: Naked, and ye clothed me: I was sick, and ye visited me: I was in prison, and ye came unto me.
我赤身露體，你們給我穿；我病了，你們看顧我；我在監裏，你們來看我。』

S.FORM: Anna ta mattæ'i-v'lli-ah tyni-æn ta matiktik, ka k'ma-ah, Meirang, ni-k'ytta'ni-an ka manno ymhou-an ka mahgangei kow, ka ni-pakan'nian ymhou-an? ka meytto kow, ka ni-pa-yt'nian ymhou-an?
S.TRANSL: Then shall the righteous answer him, saying, Lord, when saw we thee an hungred, and fed thee? or thirsty, and gave thee drink?
義人就回答說：『主啊，我們甚麼時候見你餓了，給你吃，渴了，給你喝？

S.FORM: Ka ni-kytta'nian ka manno ymhou-an ka tæ'æ̈-koua kow, ka ni-pa-ih-tallagh-nian ymhou-an? ka mannana kow, ka ni-papahkoulamough-'nian ymhou-an?
S.TRANSL: When saw we thee a stranger, and took thee in? or naked, and clothed thee?
甚麼時候見你作客旅，留你住，或是赤身露體，給你穿？

S.FORM: Ni-kytta'nian ka manno ymhou-an, ka maalam kow, ka tou sangat, ka ni-ou-koua'-ni-an ymhou-an?
S.TRANSL: Or when saw we thee sick, or in prison, and came unto thee?
又甚麼時候見你病了，或是在監裏，來看你呢？』

S.FORM: Ka mattæ'i-v'lli-ah ta Meisasou ka Sibavau, mattæ'i-k'ma-hynna neini-æn, Missing koun-nau-kamou, pæ-pynn'an-oumi pamut [ta atta] ki saat ki tæ'i-apara-au k'atta ka ousysing, ni-pamt'n-oumi [ta anna] jau-an.
S.TRANSL: And the King shall answer and say unto them, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye have done it unto one of the least of these my brethren, ye have done it unto me.
王要回答說：『我實在告訴你們，這些事你們既做在我這弟兄中一個最小的身上，就是做在我身上了。』

S.FORM: Anna ta mattæ'i-k'ma-al-appa-hynna ki sou neini-æn ka itou-u'i, D'marang-â jau-an eimoumi ka ni-pahko-avavaghen moukoua tou apoei ka myhkakoua myddarinouh, ka ni-tanangen ka â tou Lyttou-ah ki Tama-Gnau-appa tyn.
S.TRANSL: Then shall he say also unto them on the left hand, Depart from me, ye cursed, into everlasting fire, prepared for the devil and his angels:
王又要向那左邊的說：『你們這被咒詛的人，離開我！進入那為魔鬼和他的使者所預備的永火裏去！

S.FORM: Ka ni-kagangei-en-au, ka assi-moumi ni-pakan jau-an: Ni-yht-o-en-au, ka assi-'noumi ni-payt jau-an.
S.TRANSL: For I was an hungred, and ye gave me no meat: I was thirsty, and ye gave me no drink:
因為我餓了，你們不給我吃，渴了，你們不給我喝；

S.FORM: Ni-tæ'æ̈-koua-en-au, ka assi-'noumi ni-pa-ih-tallagh jau-an: Ni-pannana-en-au, ka assi-'noumi ni-papahkoulamough jau-an: Ni-kaälam-en-au, ka ni-itou-koua-en-au tou sangat, ka assi-moumi ni-k'ytt'an jau-an.
S.TRANSL: I was a stranger, and ye took me not in: naked, and ye clothed me not: sick, and in prison, and ye visited me not.
我作客旅，你們不留我住；我赤身露體，你們不給我穿；我病了，我在監裏，你們不來看顧我。』

S.FORM: Anna ta mattæ'i-v'lli-ah ta neni tyni-æn mattæ'i-k'ma-hynna, Meirang, manno ka ni-kytta'nian ymhou-an, ka mahgangei, ka meyto, ka tæ'æ̈koua, ka mannana, ka maälam, ka tou sangat lava, ka assi-mi-æn ni-illig-hen pileileigh ymhou-an?
S.TRANSL: Then shall they also answer him, saying, Lord, when saw we thee an hungred, or athirst, or a stranger, or naked, or sick, or in prison, and did not minister unto thee?
他們也要回答說：『主啊，我們甚麼時候見你餓了，或渴了，或作客旅，或赤身露體，或病了，或在監裏，不伺候你呢？』

S.FORM: Anna ta mattæ'i-v'lli-ah ta teni ki sou neini-æn, Missing koun-nau-kamou-râ: Pæ'-pynn'-an-noumi assi pamut [ta anna] ki saät ki ousyssing k'atta, assi-appa-moumi ni-pam't-en ta atta jau-an.
S.TRANSL: Then shall he answer them, saying, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye did it not to one of the least of these, ye did it not to me.
王要回答說：『我實在告訴你們，這些事你們既不做在我這弟兄中一個最小的身上，就是不做在我身上了。』

S.FORM: Ka moukoua-ah ta neni k'atta tou pæ'i-alalam-en ka myhkakoua myddarynnough: râ neni ka matiktik, tou kæuaghan ka myhkakoua myddarynnough.
S.TRANSL: And these shall go away into everlasting punishment: but the righteous into life eternal.
這些人要往永刑裏去；那些義人要往永生裏去。」
